response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine high-throughput distributed systems experience (Dunnhumby's millions-of-requests-per-second microservices) and is currently hands-on with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, directly aligning with the AI-native mindset the role requires. However, the resume shows no evidence of Python proficiency, a stated must-have, and his 15+ year history skews toward generalist full-stack/web work rather than sustained deep systems architecture, making his fit for a Staff-level distributed-systems strategy role uncertain.
strengths: Currently building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, directly matching the AI-native engineering environment
Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems experience (Dunnhumby, millions of HTTP requests/sec)
Long track record of technical leadership: founder, workshop creator, mentor, multiple 'Staff/Senior' titles
concerns: No Python mentioned anywhere in skills or work history, despite it being a must-have
Career shows heavy generalist/full-stack breadth (web design, mobile, CMS themes) rather than deep systems specialization
No explicit mention of on-call/incident response ownership or formal agile/scrum ceremony experience
